Chapter 6682: The Third Avatar?!

Chapter 6682: The Third Avatar?!

Ants and overlords feared tribulations alike. The fate of the world was at risk.

“Boom!” The tribulations erupted within the two primordial immortals, wanting to use their blood to craft the special tribulation bolt taken from Jiao Heng’s severed tribulation physique.

Cultivators normally avoided or fought the tribulations. However, they chose to nourish it with their true blood.

The bolt became larger and larger, forming a faint silhouette made from lightning and fire.

“What is that?!” An overlord shouted.

“Boom!” It was as if the high heaven had descended. The ocean lightnings moved with the giant’s hands, surging toward a single point.

The gathering waves were immensely destructive, breaking the spatial fabrics. As more gathered, the giant gained a clear outline.

It looked down on the world, no exception. Even the largest world was insignificant in comparison. This giant could revert any world to its beginning.

“Tribulation Vessel Avatar, pretty similar.” Li Qiye smiled, not afraid like the others.

Bao Pu, an immortal, felt his knees buckling. He had fought an immortal tribulation before and ascended. However, his tribulation was nothing compared to this avatar.

His trial was considered a relatively powerful one but this avatar contained countless tribulations. It was a matter of comparing a stream to an ocean.

The avatar could end any epoch and send it back to the beginning. Even if that epoch had an immortal capable of using all of the power available, the immortal would still be slain. The immortal could hide in the most secretive dimension and it would still be useless.

The avatar was not there to kill a single overlord or an immortal but to put an end to an epoch.

“Is this it for our world?” Weizhen and the others dropped to their knees.

The world didn’t know that the tribulation vessel was one of the high heaven’s three avatars. Its appearance called for the end. Only a few cultivators in history survived out of luck and the perfect circumstances.

Of course, some epochs became strong and brave enough to initiate an assault on the heaven first.

It made sense that the avatar remained a mystery. After all, the epochs that had seen it were destroyed. Later on, the avatar severed itself and became a mortal. Only a few knew the story behind this.

“Hmm, still not right, missing the will.” Li Qiye smiled and said.

“Enough to be useful.” Fiendish Ground and Evil Transformation knew the issue as well.

They roared and threw the bolt straight at Lord of Life and Death. Her unavoidable golden tribulation became attracted to it and resonated, fusing with the tribulation avatar.

“Boom!” An explosion illuminated their world and beyond.

Even those in Heaven Realm took note of this.

“Why does the high heaven still have its third avatar?!” An immortal in Heaven Realm was shocked to sense this.

The ancient immortals in Heaven Realm knew Tribulation Vessel Avatar was gone long ago. Thus, this confused them greatly.

Earlier, this avatar had monstrous potential but resembled an iron giant without a soul. Now, it had everything.
